metas.name: Toxic
metas.description: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

metas.name: KD – The Devil
metas.description: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

metas.name: Border Diaries
metas.description: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

metas.name: Yellow Board
metas.description: Journey through the lives of Bangalore's taxi drivers and their struggles, and how a hero will rise among them.

metas.name: Thota Kovi
metas.description: A witty crime-drama set in the western ghats of Karnataka.

metas.name: Bank Of Bhagyalakshmi
metas.description: A crew of five amateur thieves reunite for one final score in a village brimming with elections. With no experience and only a reckless plan, things dont go as expected.  Will they make it out, or will the village remember them only as five fools who gambled with fate?

metas.name: Uthkarsha
metas.description: A woman's body naked and her throat slit is found in a vegetable truck. Inspector Naveen is spearheading the investigation and he believes it is the doings of a psychopathic killer.

metas.name: Suri Anna
metas.description: A gripping story of a man torn between circumstances and conscience, who is drawn into the dark world of crime. As his choices spiral out of control, only the unconditional love of his parents keeps him grounded.

metas.name: Nite Road
metas.description: On a mysterious road, a man begins to suspect that his brother's death was not accidental. He shares his concerns with Inspector Daksha, who is already investigating the case. As the investigation unfolds, unsettling circumstances come to light, confirming his suspicions. Eventually, he uncovers the hidden stories of individuals who had died in accidents on that same road, revealing the concept of karma that it is not something we are born with, but something we must endure.

metas.name: Porki
metas.description: A cop disguises as a gangster in order to capture a mafia leader.

metas.name: Birbal Trilogy: Case 1 – Finding Vajramuni
metas.description: A man wrongly accused of murder is helped by Advocate Mahesh Das, despite the increasing threats they face during the investigation.

metas.name: Gultoo
metas.description: Struggling to find a foot in the start-up scene, two aspiring entrepreneurs are entangled in a vicious loop of investigative trials following an unprecedented crime.

metas.name: Rippan Swamy
metas.description: In the fictional town of sanna koppa ,the story begins with santhosh's murder.as the investigation unfolds ,Rippan swamy dives into a gripping psychological rural thriller set amidst estate workers ,town homes and hidden conflicts.

metas.name: Spark
metas.description: An investigative journalist takes on a massive bank scam, challenging a powerful cop in the process. As he digs deeper , he uncovers a deadly conspiracy that leads straight to the hidden mastermind behind it all.

metas.name: Paddayi
metas.description: Based on Macbeth, PADDAYI is the story of Madhava and Sugandhi. They are newlyweds from the fishing community in Karnataka, Southern India. Driven by a Tulu deityʼs prophecy coupled with Sugandhiʼs ambition, Madhava murders Dinesh, illegally inherits Dineshʼ property and bring upon himself an eponymous tragedy.

metas.name: 8MM Bullet
metas.description: 8MM Bullet movie is a crime thriller movie written and directed by Harikrishna and jointly produced by Narayan Swamy, Infant Pradeep and Saleem Shah while Judah Sandy scored music for this movie.  Jaggesh playing for the time different role in this movie.

metas.name: Om
metas.description: Satya, the son of a priest, leads a straightforward life until he meets the girl of his dreams. His love for her drags him into the world of crime, making him lose everyone he is close to.

metas.name: Varadanayaka
metas.description: No one has entered a biography for him.

metas.name: Kabzaa
metas.description: During the British rule in India, Arakeshwara, an air force soldier and son of a freedom fighter Amareshwara,due to unavoidable circumstances, kills Khaleed, the don of Amarapura and thus gets trapped in the mafia world and later becomes the king of the underworld. However, trouble ensues for Arakeshwara as he has to deal with his rivals and Bhargav Bhakshi, a cop sent by the British to eradicate him and the underworld.

metas.name: Accident
metas.description: Young man kills people sleeping on the footpath while driving under influence. Young man's influential father struggles to silence the police investigation and media coverage.

metas.name: Mango Pachcha
metas.description: Set in Mysuru, a crime drama unfolds across a decade (2001-2011), following a chain of events that builds tension over time. The city's setting plays a key role in reflecting different phases across the years.

metas.name: Ajith
metas.description: It is a crime movie directed by V. Somasekhar.

metas.name: Deadly Soma
metas.description: Somasekhara is a bright student. After an inter-college Kabbadi match, he gets into a tiff with a gangster's brother, which gets him involved in a crime spree.

metas.name: Case of Kondana
metas.description: In the outskirts of Bangalore lies Kondana, a fiery ASI in a fictional Bangalore outpost, clashing with a local gangster. Meanwhile, his love life with Sahana faces hurdles. ACP Lakshmi hunts a notorious criminal, while Raju struggles to save his ailing son. As these lives intertwine, a singular case in Kondana becomes the focal point, linking them all in a tale of mystery and connection.
